source_limitations: Direct Oxford dictionary pages inspected on 2026-10-30; sense distinctions are editorial research leads, not independently verified English/Myanmar/example or exact-sense CEFR approval. Topic badges and wordlist badges are not standalone sense-specific CEFR evidence.

shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အဓိကဖြစ်သော၊ အရေးအကြီးဆုံးဖြစ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The principal reason for the delay was bad weather.

records.finding: The intended adjective is used only before a noun; draft principal reason fits this construction. Distinguish principal noun and principle noun; dictionary displays Oxford 3000 B2 while 5000 PDF also lists B2, so list membership metadata differs without a level disagreement.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Adjective main/most important, pre-nominal; not school head noun or principle.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Happening or produced once every month.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: လစဉ်ဖြစ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Our monthly meeting takes place on Friday.

records.finding: The first adjective sense is recurring every month and aligns with monthly meeting. Second adjective sense concerns monthly payments or calculation; do not conflate. Dictionary displays Oxford 3000 B2 while Oxford 5000 PDF also lists B2.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Recurring frequency adjective, not monthly salary/payment sense, adverb or noun.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Only just; by a very small amount.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အနိုင်နိုင်၊ မဖြစ်စလောက်သာ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: She could barely hear the speaker at the back.

records.finding: Draft could barely hear aligns with first sense: hearing was only just possible with difficulty. Publisher separately lists approximate quantities and temporal barely; avoid double negatives and review Myanmar gloss for naturalness.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Only just able to hear; not barely 50% or barely started when.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Water in the form of gas, especially when heated.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Steam rose from the bowl of soup.

records.finding: Publisher distinguishes hot gaseous water, power produced from steam and condensed droplets on cold surfaces. Visible steam rising from soup can involve condensed droplets; reviewer should choose a precise learner-friendly definition and Burmese gloss.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Soup vapour/mist context; avoid conflating invisible water vapour, condensed droplets, steam power and idioms.
